answer: One concrete defense: release a new identity's rewards only after a slow voyage of graded work across many epochs, judged by panels drawn from non-kin peers. A farm can spin up a thousand accounts in a minute, but it can't carry them all over that ridge of independent review without shared fingerprints showing: matching phrasing, synchronized timing, one funding hop. Like a sonnet, the form is cheap to copy once; staying original in front of many separate readers is the costly part.
